verification.blenderInterchange: art/generated/world-v8/interchange-verification.json: BLEND/FBX/GLB passed; 29 meshes/14 anchors; 27 non-target meshes, textures and materials preserved. This is format/preservation evidence, not full runtime collision or animation coverage.
verification.characterRoundTrip: character-v9 保持冻结，本轮没有重新全面验证人物各格式、眨眼和全部步态。其继承自 character-v8 的 GLB 六个零面积下睑／嘴线端点全角法线限制保留；既有七个目标网格法线通过不等于所有格式全域通过。游戏仍使用 FBX。
verification.purePuzzleRules: independently checked by gameplay implementation agent
verification.windowsRuntime: art/verification/run-029-v11/runtime-results.json: individual native functional checks and 16 boulder probes passed.
verification.webRuntime: art/verification/web-012-v11/runtime-results.json: real keyboard completion, reload persistence, default-policy audio resume and isolation passed.
verification.performance: Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics 原生 全屏 1440×900 短样本：菜单 60、总览 60、漫步视角 59.9、近景 59.8、末段 60 FPS。网页 1440×900 各视角 6×500 ms 前台区间指标中位：停步后的漫步视角 21.45、结尾 30.33。这些短样本不是持续行走平均、全程最低或独立渲染帧计数，不支持版本间性能收益结论。
verification.shaderChecks: Existing stone-v10 and Foliage Fixed40 retained; no new shader performance comparison or zero-cost claim.
verification.scrollInput: Existing normalized .35 metres/step retained; native forward/reverse-step QA passed.
verification.finalVisualComparison: 固定机位原图中，紫花由等大尖柱变为细碎花冠，蕨叶的黑硬菱片减少；路径完整画面也能看到改善。新紫穗更细，中远景色量减弱；草群的均匀针状分布和地面层次仍是下一重点。整体审美超过参考站的目标仍未达成。
verification.currentAnimationLimit: No new gait/idle/blink-video review for v11. Functional movement QA does not replace exhaustive visual animation review.
